title: Continuum-Interaction-Driven Intelligence: Human-Aligned Neural Architecture via Crystallized Reasoning and Fluid Generation
reasoning: The paper proposes a dual-channel neural architecture (Neuromorphic Intelligence Architecture) to improve reasoning and alignment in LLMs. While it mentions 'trustworthy AI' and the necessity of 'ethical frameworks' for high-stakes domains like healthcare, it does not evaluate or benchmark religion, morals, or ethics.
